title: Grain Ports Resume Operations as Government Suspends Deregulation Decree
detail: Argentina's grain ports returned to normal operations after the government agreed to temporarily suspend the river-navigation deregulation decree that triggered the maritime pilots' strike, and negotiated a reduction in sector tariffs. The roughly 24-hour stoppage had paused a significant share of the country's foreign trade; talks with the pilots' union and other stakeholders are continuing.

media.caption: Argentina resumes grain exports after the pilots' strike ends
